label: Inputs/criteria frozen before any model generation
design: Paired shared first draft; same Writer prompt/context/role in both arms. ADTF reuses that exact first draft and adds current unmodified Reviewer/policy/revision loop. No human feedback during generation.
qualityEvaluation: Anonymous endpoint pairs with random method-independent IDs. Primary: Codex root rubric scoring before opening provenance or other ratings; then manual criticism/repair audit with before/after evidence. Optional independent-context Gemini corroboration is separate, not required to establish a result. Judge inputs exclude arm names, review outcomes, usage and history.
sourceChangesAfterGeneration: No production prompt/policy changes based on this set; future tuning needs separate cases.
failures: Retain all starts/failures; no implicit paid retry; interrupted jobs are not replayed. Incomplete arms are reported, not approved or counted as improved.
primaryProjects: All .adtf files protected by pre/post file hashes; use isolated TEST/STUB memory and demo approval only.
money: Record physical usage and separate per-arm shared-v1 allocation; never sum shared call twice. Estimate USD only from captured official rate snapshot, distinct from actual cloud invoice.

scoring.primary: Codex root evaluates all anonymized endpoint candidates with evidence before opening mapping; this is a blinded presentation, not an external human panel.
scoring.secondary: Optional same-model Gemini independent-context corroboration, not required; same-model bias remains. Primary manual scoring is sealed before viewing any optional grades.
scoring.feedback: Codex root audits recorded criticism and repair before/after evidence after primary blind scoring. Optional same-model audit remains separate and is labeled if used.
scoring.ties: Identical endpoint texts must be noted; disagreement in model ratings is rater noise, not process benefit.

portability: Generation protects original .adtf before/after. Portable grading protects the current executor .adtf separately; original post-run state is evidenced by generation receipt, not re-read remotely.
configurationLimit: ADTF is bounded to three planning iterations for this evaluation, not its five-iteration production sample configuration. Results apply to this frozen setting.
primaryState: Preserve initial and final production .adtf snapshots. Synthetic fixture approvals exist only under isolated run folders; no actual Scope/Plan user approval is created.
tokenAccounting: Keep candidate, thinking and cached input metrics separate; unknown metrics are not fabricated. Price subtotal is a quoted-rate estimate, not the GCP invoice.
interpretation: Report paired scores together with major/critical defects, regression and approval readiness. Higher score with new critical defects is not accepted as a quality win. Same-content score differences are rater noise, not ADTF improvement.
